text:
Totally fair — just planning a cross-country move is exhausting, let alone doing it. Take a break. The checklist will still be there tomorrow.

If it helps: you don't have to tackle any of it tonight. You've got 10 weeks, and the first real deadlines aren't for a few days. Close the laptop, take the dog for a walk, order dinner.

When you're ready to pick it back up, just say the word and I'll finish the one-page moving-day essentials for you too.
